title: EtherCAT Init
text: Initialize EtherCAT main device node with data in the EtherCAT Network Information (ENI) file, 1 output, {Initialization End State} sets End state after creating master; {Config file (ENI)} sets the eNI file from the EtherCAT configurator character, {Network Device Index} sets the etherCAT network identifier 0-15, {Ethernet Port Number} sets the port number in target, {DC Tuning} sets the distributed clock initialization parameter Large and {Enable EtherCAT Log for Debugging} sets the access to debugging and logging block. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Status information about the EtherCAT network vector

params.name: Config file (ENI)
params.values: ENI file from the EtherCAT configurator character vector

params.name: Ethernet Port Number
params.values: Port number in target computer int

params.name: Initialization End State
params.values: End state after creating master Op (default) | PreOp | SafeOp

params.name: DC Tuning
params.values: Distributed clock initialization parameter Large model (default) | Medium model | Small model

params.name: Enable EtherCAT Log for Debugging
params.values: Access to debugging and logging block parameters Off (default) | Warning | Info | Verbose | All
